{{Top|leg}}
An '''identity band''' was mounted on the side of a cargo module, and carried information on the container's contents. The identity band was able to be read by a [[Loader droid/Legends|freight droid's]] [[Laser scanner/Legends|laser scanner]] to determine where the module should be off-loaded. The information on the identity band could be recoded by the laser scanner when new cargo was loaded into the module.<ref name="HSCSS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
